sources: Hanabi rules (R&R Games / Cocktail Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: 8 blue clock tokens faceup; the 4 black Fuse tokens stacked with the longest fuse on top and the explosion at the bottom
steps.note: The multicolor suit is for the advanced variants only

steps.text: Shuffle the cards and deal {n} to each player
Hold your cards facing outward - never look at your own
The player with the most colorful clothing begins; play is clockwise
